name: Midas Spirit: Farokh
description:
The Spirit of Rug Radio’s Farokh greets you with an enthusiastic “GM”. If greeted by this Spirit, this means that your room has become a focal point of discussion or attention. Congratulations! By passing The Spirit to a trusted community member holding a Forever Supper Core Room - you will be granted access to gold.

This is an Expansion Item for Forever Supper, the biggest cryptoart collaboration. Claim your free Core and customise it with the Expansions you collect here: https://async.market/dynamic-blueprints/63fe742c74e62000a8cf7bb8/async-forever-supper
